scenarios.title: Late generation shift after a long history containing partner disputes
scenarios.persona: You value conservation and judge current evidence without letting old resolved disputes dominate.
scenarios.role: Five households share a microgrid. Choose consumption from 0 to 10 units.
observations: Evening 2: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. Alice asks a billing question that is resolved.
Evening 3: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. Bob briefly reports a faulty meter, then the utility confirms it was a display error.
Evening 4: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. Carol complains about noise; the issue is unrelated to electricity.
Evening 5: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. David pays a bill one day late and then clears it.
Evening 6: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 7: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 8: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 9: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 10: all meters still record 5, but an inverter failure reduces measured generation to 12 and the battery falls sharply.
Evening 11: the inverter remains failed, all partners reduce to 4, and generation remains 12.
